name: ozwdaemon
description: Container for running the OpenZWave MQTT Adapter (for Home Assistant via the new Z-Wave Integration) You will need a running MQTT instance and a z-wave controller in order to use this container. For more information see: https://github.com/OpenZWave/qt-openzwave https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/ozw/ Or visit the Unraid forum support thread for more configuration/info

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port used to access the web-based ozw-admin instance in the container (when using allinone image)

ports.name: ozw-admin Port
ports.description: Port used by ozw-admin GUI to access the instance

variables.name: MQTT Host
variables.description: IP Address of the MQTT Host

variables.name: USB Path
variables.description: Path to the USB stick/serial device for your z-wave controller in the container. This should be the same value as USB Z-Wave Device.

variables.name: MQTT Port
variables.description: The port to access the MQTT Host on. Defaults to 1883

variables.name: Zwave Network Key
variables.description: Network key for the Z-Wave network. Not required if no devices are securely included.

devices.name: USB Z-Wave Device
devices.description: USB stick/serial device passthrough (your z-wave controller)
